newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Notionnel to bounce to 130.20, flat market.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Notionnel to bounce to 130.20, flat market.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will bounce towards 130.20 on Wednesday but the underlying trend was fairly neuteral, analysts said.
"Notionnel should find a good base around 129.70 and we should see a rebound back to 130.20 again," said Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrie Lullin in Geneva.
The area around 130.20 represents last week's mid-week lows.
Notionnel futures were quoted at 130.06 by 0821 GMT, up 0.42 from their prior close.
Over the next few days Bado said he expected the market to correct the decline from the highs around 130.80 to 129.55.
